title: My first game, 3.5 months of work - Bone to Pick, a forensic mystery visual novel
author: maikoo811
selftext:
[Bone to Pick](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4996240/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=sns_en) is a mystery visual novel set in a forensic anthropology lab. You clean bones, lay them out on a skeletal chart, fit broken fragments together, rebuild a face from a skull with clay, and question suspects with the evidence.

I've always loved Bones and wanted a game where you solve cases by reading the bones. Making it with AI, I figured a niche topic was the way to go. Some media ended up covering it, and since I released the demo a week ago, over 3,000 people have wishlisted it. The demo survey gave me feedback on two things: the translation, and the game being too easy. Those are what I'm working on next.

Made with Claude Code, Gemini and Suno. Free demo on Steam.
